verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage has a documented versioning page stating that a new endpoint version ships whenever a backwards-incompatible change is released. Versioned endpoints (v2, v3) appear in the API reference, and one legacy lookup endpoint returns a 308 Permanent Redirect. However, the evidence never documents a deprecation policy (notice periods, sunset timelines, or deprecation headers), which is half of the story. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, deprecation signaling (headers or changelog), and independent corroboration of version stability.
